alternatives_rejected.why: E1 shows a massive emailservice_cpu deviation (z=554, +5951%), which a network delay would not cause; CPU saturation better explains the inbound queuing latency in E2.

alternatives_rejected.candidate: checkoutservice: degraded by slow emailservice dependency
alternatives_rejected.why: checkoutservice latency-90 deviation (+756%) is far smaller than emailservice's (+36325%) in E1, and inbound calls to emailservice slowed 22x in E2, so checkout is a downstream victim.

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the CPU-hogging process or workload in the emailservice pod. Raise emailservice CPU limits or scale out replicas to relieve request queuing, then confirm emailservice CPU and checkout latency return to baseline.
